description: This file defines the MemoryAdapterFactory class, a generic factory and adapter for in-memory stream providers in Orleans, used for testing. It handles creation of stream adapters, cache management, queue grain retrieval, and message queuing.

classes.name: MemoryAdapterFactory`1
classes.description: A factory and adapter class for in-memory stream provider in Orleans, supporting serialization, queuing, caching, and failure handling.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes internal structures like queue grains and monitors, and sets default factories if not assigned.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Returns the current instance as an IQueueAdapter wrapped in a task.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the factory itself as the cache.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Provides the stream queue mapper used for routing streams to queues.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory stream receiver for a specific queue.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Queues a batch of messages asynchronously into the in-memory stream grain.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a cache for a specific queue, initializing buffer pools if needed.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Gets or creates a failure handler for message delivery failures.

methods.name: GenerateDeterministicGuid
methods.description: Generates a deterministic GUID based on queue ID and factory name hash.

methods.name: GetQueueGrain
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a queue grain for a specific queue ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create and initialize an instance of MemoryAdapterFactory given a service provider and name.
